currency.basis: The operating bank's currently fetched homepage presents this vector in its current header alongside active banking services and October 2026 news.

identity.basis: Metadata host and Ukrainian KREDOBANK identity exactly match the official site's bank description/header. Parent PKO is ownership context only, not substituted.

assessment.independenceRationale: All observations are one official publication group, not claimed as independent sources. Primary current-use and direct original-vector evidence resolve the research gap; third-party/image search would add no necessary evidence.

variant.basis: The header explicitly separates this standalone chevron asset from the wordmark, and the official touch icon visually matches its orange-chevron variant. Transparent standalone mark is suitable in principle for a square cell without adding a backing. Full square and small-size Compose checks remain candidate-stage work.

candidate.detailsJudgement: Full original independent raster and exact source/final pairs show preserved rounded ends, tip, inner corner, #f18b00 fill and alpha. Compose final matches geometry without clipping on both themes.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: Whole source emblem uniformly placed in square viewport, complete fit and preserved aspect ratio; orange remains clear on both themes. Resized 24/32/48px diagnostics inspected and recognizable; diagnostics are not native mobile evidence.
candidate.rationale: Use the bank's currently published original orange transparent chevron, correcting the accepted white-on-muted-orange variant and straight-ended geometry without claiming a dated rebrand.

transforms: Preserved original full path geometry and #f18b00 paint. Replaced stylesheet class with equivalent explicit fill; removed nonvisual title/layer wrappers. No tracing, recoloring, stretching, rotation, clipping or raster embedding.

candidate.visibleDiffExplanation: White angular chevron on muted-orange circle becomes source-supported orange transparent chevron with rounded left ends; meaningful color, geometry and presentation correction.

proposals.reason: Official current KREDOBANK header publishes a standalone original orange #f18b00 chevron, also visually corroborated by its official touch icon. The accepted file instead uses a white angular chevron on an #E49439 circle, with straight end corners. A supported replacement corrects the source color/presentation and rounded end geometry; no rebrand date is claimed.

sourceCandidate.rationale: Replace unsupported white-on-muted-orange presentation and straight end geometry with the actual current original orange transparent chevron. Source geometry and #f18b00 fill are preserved; only whole-emblem placement within a square viewport is proposed.

sources.observation: Fetched official homepage identifies KREDOBANK as a Ukrainian bank founded in 1990, owned by PKO Bank Polski; its header link titled KredoBank separately references arrowLogo.svg and textLogo.svg. Current services, 2026 copyright, NBU license and October 2026 news support active current use. Independently rendered arrowLogo.svg is a clean orange right chevron with slightly rounded left ends and transparent interior/exterior; the 410-byte SVG contains one simple authored path, no raster or trace metadata.

Official homepage-linked 180px touch image was directly inspected: orange right chevron with rounded left ends and no orange field/white chevron. This is visual corroboration only, never candidate geometry. File bytes decode as JPEG despite PNG URL.
